messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion to staging blocked: integration-test-suite failed on service-search migration step. Test run id: ci-2026-03-21-22-04.

tasha: ugh. which test is failing exactly?

deploy-bot: failing test: search/migrations/test_migrate_schema.py::test_migrate_index_jobs
logs:
```
2026-03-21T22:02:13Z ERROR: migration 20260321_01 failed: duplicate key value violates unique constraint \"idx_jobs_pkey\"
Traceback (most recent call last): UniqueViolation(\"duplicate key\")
```

ryan: that migration previously passed in canary. could be a race with the background indexer job.

carla: are we sure the canary used the exact same DB snapshot? last week we saw snapshot drift between regions.

qa-bot: canary pipeline run ci-2026-03-21-19-40 used db-snap: dbsnap-eu-20260321-1830. This staging run used dbsnap-eu-20260321-2000.

ryan: different snapshot -> different existing rows, so the migration encountering dup keys makes sense. Options: 1) abort promotion and pin to previous passing build (fast), 2) run migration with defensive dedupe step and re-run CI (slower), 3) re-run staging with the older snapshot to validate (medium).

tasha: change window ends in ~25 mins. if we want to keep release momentum we should pin and follow up. But we need a postmortem to avoid silent snapshot divergence.

ops-bot: reminder: database snapshot restore will take ~7m + 3m for service warmup.

carla: i can start a restore to the canary snapshot now if we want to repro and be safe. but that will push the window.

ryan: i'm +1 for PIN_TO_PREV. We'll promote the last green artifact and open a follow-up ticket to add idempotent upserts to the migration and reconcile snapshots (INFRA-4834).

qa-bot: ACTION REQUIRED: choose PROMOTE_PIN / REBUILD_WITH_DEDUPE / DELAY. @tasha @ryan please ack.

tasha: PROMOTE_PIN from me. please add release notes and create the follow-up.

deploy-bot: Manual promote command executed by ryan at 3785554402: `deploybot promote --from-tag v2026-canary-42 --to staging --reason \"pin: migration snapshot drift\"`

deploy-bot: Pre-promote checks: registry ok, smoke tests run. Smoke tests: FAIL (flaky startup dependent on migration). Retrying smoke suite...

deploy-bot: Smoke tests: PASS. Promotion to staging completed at 3785554469.

deploy-bot: Block cleared. Recommendation: add migration idempotency and snapshot reconciliation to INFRA-4834; schedule a rebuild of v2026-03-21-2200 with the dedupe migration and run full integration tests.

carla: filing INFRA-4834 now: \"db snapshot drift causes migration unique constraint failure; add idempotent migration + snapshot hygiene\".

tasha: release notes line: \"Staging pinned to previous green artifact due to migration uniqueness failure; follow-up INFRA-4834.\"

ryan: thanks. closing this thread. will follow up in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
